name: Descriptive Essay
purpose: Makes the reader experience a person, place, or thing rather than just being told about it.

components.note: Ties back to the dominant impression rather than summarizing facts about the subject.

organizational_patterns.name: Spatial
organizational_patterns.description: Moves through the subject by physical layout (near to far, top to bottom, room to room).

organizational_patterns.name: Chronological
organizational_patterns.description: Describes a subject as it changes or is experienced over time (a storm passing, a meal being eaten).

organizational_patterns.name: Order of Importance
organizational_patterns.description: Orders details from least to most (or most to least) central to the dominant impression.

pitfalls: Details listed without a unifying impression — reads as a list, not a picture.
No organizing principle, so the reader can't reconstruct the whole from the parts.
Figurative language that describes the writer's cleverness more than the subject.
